brick.name: Canyon Brake Test
brick.intent: Brake before the marked right turn, then accelerate out.
brick.entry: Straight, zero grade, centered car; three or more seconds to prepare.
brick.exit: Straight relief, zero grade, explicit completion before the road buffer.
